## About
Gran Turismo East is a tire and alignment shop at 3306 Shallowford Road in Chamblee. We carry tires from all major brands, mount and balance them, and align your car based on the kind of driving you plan to be doing.
We also handle brake work and suspension setup, whether you need to replace worn parts or fine-tune what you have. Neighbors have rated us 4.8 from 413 Google reviews, and many mention our honest, fair pricing and the care we put into every car.

## Services
- Tires from all major brands: A full selection of advanced tires, with knowledgeable staff to help you pick the right one.
- On-car high-speed balancing: Balancing done on the car for a smoother, safer ride. Pair it with a performance alignment for better handling.
- High-performance 4-wheel alignments: Alignments set up on our Hawkeye Elite system for the kind of driving you plan to do.
- Tire mounting: Mounting for wheels from 10 inches up to 26 inches, with extreme care to keep your rims in good shape.
- Brake repair: Maintenance, repair or replacement, including pads, rotors, calipers and resurfacing.
- Suspension setup: Replacing worn or weathered suspension components, or fine-tuning your setup.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring tires I bought online?
A: Yes. One longtime customer orders her tires online and has them set up here.

Q: Can you align a car with a modified suspension?
A: Yes. We have done custom alignments on customized suspensions to the owner's specs, and we walk you through the results when you pick up.

Q: Can I come in later on Thursday?
A: Yes, later times on Thursday are available by appointment only.
